notes.after: who are at Philippi, with the overseers
notes.text: The word translated "overseers" (episkopos) can also be translated superintendents, guardians, curators, or bishops.

notes.after: Philippi, with the overseers and deacons

notes.text: The word translated "partnership" (koinonia) also means "fellowship" and "sharing."

notes.after: Now I desire to have you know, brothers,
notes.text: The word for "brothers" here and where context allows may also be correctly translated "brothers and sisters" or "siblings."
